description: Show where the user's requests stand and what happens next. Call it after you started a request, when the user asks how it is going, or before answering a call time. With no task_id it lists their most recent requests. Read-only. The answer has a state and a next_action: respond_to_call_time means you can help now, person_decides_on_website means the user must open the link (prices, approvals and cards are never handled here), and wait means nothing is needed.

task_id.description: The request to look at. Leave it out to list the most recent ones.

name: get_task_status
title: See where a request stands
